title: Tighten Kong rate-limit on /public-statements endpoints from 60/min to 30/min
description: Customer support reports increased scraping-bot traffic on the public-statements-api via /v1/statements/* endpoints. Halving the rate limit at the Kong layer (per-IP) per ADR-001 plugin config. No backend code change.
diff:
diff --git a/kong/plugins/rate-limiting/public_statements.yaml
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 config:
   policy: local
-  minute: 60
+  minute: 30
   hour: 1000
